text:
kai_sales: heads-up — AcmeRetail signed LOI and wants a private deployment. Requirements: Azure VNet peering, Thales HSM integration, and an air-gapped option. Sales needs a feasibility summary + rough timeline by EOW. Can product/eng triage?

jordan_pm: pinging infra + eng. Quick Qs: do they expect our control plane inside their VPC or a private control plane we deploy into their network? Also what SLA are they expecting?

alex_infra: we can do VNet peering + HSM integration, but airgap + HSM + private control plane increases operational scope significantly. Need customer network diagram, KMS certs, and approval for maintenance windows.

maria_support: they mentioned p99 latency target <200ms in the intake form. Do we recommend Dedicated nodes for that? Any rough sizing guidance to give sales?

sara_prod: propose launch criteria for negotiation: 1) end-to-end inference validated in staging inside customer network; 2) HSM/KMS keys integrated and audited; 3) monitoring/alerts wired to their pager; 4) documented rollback and upgrade plan. If any item fails, hold GA.

devon_engineer: rough timelines from infra perspective — path A (Dedicated + Azure peering + HSM, control plane remotely reachable over private peering): ~6–8 weeks assuming no hardware procurement delays. Path B (fully airgapped / on-prem control plane): ~12–16 weeks, depends on procurement and on-site validation. Need GPU SKU and estimated QPS.

kai_sales: they're pushing for 6 weeks. How firm is the 6-week estimate if they insist on HSM?

alex_infra: 6 weeks is realistic only if we can have TLS egress to our control plane over private peering and customer provides certs + network ACLs quickly. No outbound (fully airgapped) pushes us to the longer timeline. Also extra time for HSM test harnesses.

jordan_pm: action items: 1) kai_sales to get network diagram, GPU SKU, and SOC attestation by Wed; 2) devon_engineer to draft runbook/checklist for HSM, firewall rules, cert exchange, and maintenance windows; 3) sara_prod to turn launch criteria into a one-pager for sales; 4) schedule a 30-min triage call with customer + infra. Who can own the runbook draft?

devon_engineer: I can own the runbook draft. I'll include placeholders for Thales HSM certs, Azure Private Link configuration, NAT/firewall examples, sample ssh jumpbox steps, and a simple smoke test script (`curl` + model health checks).

deploy-bot: ticket PRIV-842 created by kai_sales: "AcmeRetail private deploy intake - initial triage"

kai_sales: thanks everyone — I'll push legal for SOC docs and share network diagram once I have it. Will update the ticket with timeline constraints from the customer. :thumbsup:
